message.content:
A blue-textured magazine cover features a red vertical stripe along its left edge. A large, teal, translucent syringe occupies much of the center, curving into a loose S-shape. A human hand with red fingers emerges from behind the syringe's midsection, gripping its barrel. Above the syringe, a figure with red skin and long dark hair, wearing a white coat and black pants, appears to be falling or reclining backward toward the right. Their right arm is raised with fingers splayed. The background contains the large, faded white word "TEMPO" in a serif typeface.

Yellow and white text at the bottom left reads "PELAN IMUNISASI NASIONAL" in a sans-serif font. Below this, smaller white text begins with "IMUNISASI CAMPAK DITOLAK..." and ends with "...FATWA TENTANG VAKSIN?". Top headlines include "BUKA-BUKAAN TERSANGKA SUAP PEMBANGKIT" and "MORAT-MARIT BPJS KESEHATAN." A barcode and issue information, "24-30 SEPTEMBER 2018," are located in the bottom right corner. The illustration style is textured and painterly.
